intro.text: An Eelakin title held on every island, even the minor, out-of-the-way ones.
Eelakin officials who by tradition choose the successors of the chiefs and appoint new loremothers.

description.text: Kingmakers take part in the leaders' meetings alongside chiefs, generals, senators and officials.
They choose new loremothers and oversee their teaching.
A few also hold a vote in the Eelakin government's Traditional House.
